**Evidence / how it holds together:**
- All four channels returned `has_more: false`, so the top-level history is complete. `messages = top-level (non-reply) + thread replies`; broadcast replies appear in history but are counted once (as replies) via the thread reads.
- Every thread parent (`thread_ts == ts`) was opened. The reply count retrieved from each thread **matched its `reply_count` summary exactly** in all 17 threads (2+2+6+7), so nothing underneath was missed — this is the "summary line tells you how much is under it; the thread read told me who put it there."
- Replies were taken from the thread reads; distinct repliers union to 15 (no cross-room overlap), and the global openers set (12 thread-parent authors) was used to mark the 8 outside replies from 6 accounts who never opened a thread in these rooms.
- Hidden and bot/file-share messages were all counted (e.g., the hidden `UNN2VSEY3JSW` reply in `security-v3-065`, the `bot_message` self-reply by `UWGCP00XPDCQ`).
